name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedLeaf.untwisted_separator_iff
title: Untwisted constraint block: a leaf separator exists iff the falsified clauses admit weights summing to 1 on every assignment
statement: Over a field K, with finite clause index kappa and block index nu, sets U z of falsified clauses, nonzero clause weights j_k and a nonzero vector v: there is l on kappa x nu with ((if k in U z then j_k else 0) * v_i)_{(k,i)} . l = 1 for all z if and only if there are weights lam on clauses with sum over k in U z of lam_k = 1 for all z.
